_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: onboarding / first-time brand or company-profile setup. Should-not-trigger: a plain brand analysis (analyzing-brand), key/machine setup (supercmo-setup), generating creative, and an off-topic control. Bare 'set up' is deliberately NOT a keyword — it would steal supercmo-setup's and generic setup queries.

cases.query: set up my brand for acme.com
onboard me, our site is glowskin.co
build out my company profile so future chats know my brand
i'm getting started with supercmo, what do you need from me
analyze my brand from our website
which api keys do i need to configure
make a ugc video for my serum
what's the weather in Tokyo today
